idea-plugin.name: Review Hub
idea-plugin.description:
Review Hub for JetBrains IDEs

The safe review bridge for autonomous AI coding agents. Always see what AI agents proposed, navigate changes, and accept or reject individual hunks before anything touches your disk.

Works natively with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Aider, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Roo via native embedded MCP server (SSE).

Key Features

  • Native Embedded MCP Server: Runs locally on port 49182 (SSE) as soon as you open the IDE. No Node.js runtime or npm install needed!
  • In-Memory Staging: AI edits are staged safely in memory before touching your files on disk.
  • In-Editor Inline Review: Visual color highlights, gutter markers, and single-click ✓Accept | ✕Reject inlay annotations.
  • Compact Floating Header Bar: Quick Accept/Reject and Next/Prev hunk navigation directly on top of active editor tabs.
  • Checkpoint Snapshot & One-Click Rollback: Automatic pre-AI snapshots let you revert entire sessions back to baseline with peace of mind.
  • Sub-Millisecond Myers Diff: High-performance diffing with automatic CRLF vs LF and indentation normalization.
  • MCP Agent Feedback Loop: Exposes get_review_status so autonomous AI agents know whether proposals were approved.
  • Status Bar & Project Tree Badges: Always see pending files and hunk counts at a glance.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.1.1

  • Myers Diff Engine: High-performance Myers diff algorithm with prefix/suffix trimming for sub-millisecond hunk computation.
  • Checkpoint Snapshot & Rollback: One-click restore to baseline state, undoing AI edits if builds break.
  • Compact Editor Review Bar: Streamlined 4-button header with Accept/Reject file and Next/Prev hunk navigation.
  • MCP Agent Feedback: Added get_review_status and rollback_checkpoint tools for autonomous AI agent loops.
  • Fuzzy Indentation Matcher: Automatic normalization of CRLF vs LF and spaces vs tabs.
  • Status Bar & Project View: Live change indicators and pending hunks badges.

v0.1.0

  • Initial release with embedded MCP server on port 49182 (SSE).
  • In-editor inline review with accept/reject hunk inlays.
  • ToolWindow tree view for staged changes.
